name: accessibility-audit
description: Browser-driven WCAG accessibility audit suite. A router skill fingerprints a live page and dispatches category sub-skills (structure, images/media, form labels, interactive names, focus visibility, contrast) as parallel subagents, merging their results into one fix-ready Markdown report. Includes a standalone keyboard-dropdown audit. All checks run through playwright-cli against the live DOM/CSSOM — never by reading source code.
